segments.content:
Rekindling the Verdant Years Chapter 152: Y-You, Don't Come In

When Li Luo received Yan Zhusheng's gift, it was still a while before the evening self-study session.

After the two finished discussing their plans for the weekend, Zhu Yufei and Zhang Guohuang walked in through the back door.

They were chatting as they walked.

"Have you read that book, 'Not a Star,' recently?"

"Nah, I'm letting the chapters build up," Zhu Yufei said. "It's such a cliffhanger. Damn it, he won't get together with any of the female leads. It's frustrating to read."

"That's not the point," Zhang Guohuang said, wagging his finger. "You don't know this, but this book has gotten really popular in the community lately."

"How so? Don't tell me he wrote some kind of deal-breaker plot point?"

"Not that," Zhang Guohuang said. "Didn't the author write an original song and release it before?"

"And?"

"Last night, I heard my mom humming a tune while she was cooking, and it turned out to be that song, 'Annual Rings'." Zhang Guohuang said with a click of his tongue. "I didn't think much of it at first, until she turned on the TV to watch a drama called 'Immortal Fate of the Jade Pool'."

"The moment the theme song started playing, it hit me."

"Isn't that the song 'Annual Rings'?"

Zhu Yufei raised an eyebrow. "Someone actually bought that song?"

"That song 'Annual Rings' is super popular now," Zhang Guohuang said. "It seems to be sung by a female singer named Yuan Wanqing. She was really famous over a decade ago, my mom used to be a fan of hers for a while."

"So that's all you've been talking about," Zhu Yufei rolled his eyes. "When is this damn author going to write more?"

"How should I know." Zhang Guohuang looked helpless. "He's already pretty good, churning out six or seven thousand words a day without fail. Much better than those who take days off every now and then."

Yan Zhusheng listened to their complaints with great interest from the side, glancing at Li Luo from time to time as she listened.

Her stares made Li Luo feel completely speechless.

This feeling of being discussed by acquaintances right in front of him, while the person they were discussing was his own alias, he really didn't know how to describe it.

After all, being praised was quite nice, but while he was being praised, these two guys would casually drop a "damn author" or "damn it," which was really hard to take.

The crucial part was that his deskmate knew about his alias.

This was killing him.

Fortunately, Zhu Yufei and Zhang Guohuang only chatted for a little while before moving on to other topics.

The evening self-study session soon began.

Li Luo entered a state of focus, opening the second-year high school textbooks he had borrowed from Xu Youyu to start previewing the material.

Only after he truly started to understand the learning methods of academic aces like Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu and their usual study progress did Li Luo truly grasp what it took to reach that level.

In his previous life, when he was in high school, it wasn't until around the first semester of his senior year that he finished learning all the coursework and entered the review stage.

But for academic aces like Ying Chanxi, they had already encountered a lot of high school and even university-level content when they participated in competitions in middle school.

Once they got into high school, the summer pre-session classes immediately cranked the intensity up to the max.

By the end of the first semester of their first year, the students in the honors class had pretty much finished learning all the high school material.

Even the slower ones could catch up during the second semester of their first year.

By the second year, they were completely focused on competitions.

When the third year arrived, even the students who failed in the competitions only needed a few months to review the high school content to quickly return to their normal level and take the college entrance exam with ease.

The gap between people was truly not a small one.

If it weren't for a bug-level ability like the Memory Palace, Li Luo wouldn't be confident he could match Ying Chanxi's learning progress and efficiency, even with a second chance at life.

Fortunately, Li Luo wasn't deliberately pursuing that. He had no interest in competitions; after all, they took up too much time.

At his current pace, he estimated he could finish self-studying the second-year content this semester.

Next semester, he would strive to finish all the third-year content as well.

This way, his second and third years of high school would be much more relaxed, giving him more time to dabble in other things.

After all, with the Memory Palace, he would never forget anything he had learned once, so he didn't have to worry about getting rusty over time.

"When you have time in the future, teach me how to play the piano," Li Luo suddenly said to Yan Zhusheng.

He hadn't really used the "soul possession" function since he had figured it out.

Since his high school studies no longer posed any significant difficulty for him, he might as well take the time to learn a few more skills, just to cultivate his character.

Yan Zhusheng didn't think about the reason why Li Luo suddenly wanted to learn piano from her. She was just slightly taken aback, then nodded. "Okay."

And just like that, they had an agreement.

The two continued with their evening self-study.

Occasionally, Yan Zhusheng would pass over her exercise book or test paper, point to a certain problem with her pen, and ask Li Luo for help.

Li Luo would study it, but in reality, he would directly find the detailed solution for the corresponding problem in his Memory Palace's question bank, and then explain it carefully to Yan Zhusheng.

Because Li Luo's seat was in the corner by the window, as long as they spoke softly, they wouldn't disturb the other students.

So it wasn't just Yan Zhusheng; occasionally, other students who encountered difficult problems would also quietly slip over to ask Li Luo for help.

After all, finding a teacher meant climbing two flights of stairs. It was more convenient to ask Li Luo.

Especially since Li Luo never refused anyone, and when he explained the problems, his solution process was exactly the same as what the teachers would say in class.

He wasn't like Lu Jiahao, whose problem-solving approach was wild and unrestrained, with flexible leaps in logic that many people couldn't follow.

Especially for math problems. To Lu Jiahao, after one look at the problem statement, many conditions were self-proven in his subconscious, ready to be used.

For him, it was as natural as an instinct.

But other students couldn't keep up with such speed and would always get stuck on the derivation of certain conditions.

In contrast, Li Luo himself was a math slacker, so he could understand the difficulties these students faced and could always unravel the problem and explain it clearly.

So over time, the students in the class preferred to ask Li Luo for help with their questions.

Towards the end of the second evening self-study session, Yan Zhusheng next to him gave Li Luo a signal.

Li Luo understood with pleasure, pretended to go to the bathroom, but actually made his way to the sports field and met up with Yan Zhusheng, who had come downstairs after him.

Yan Zhusheng skillfully placed one earbud into Li Luo's ear and turned on the music on her phone.

Then, the two of them started jogging on the field to exercise.

As their fixed daily routine, except for Saturdays, the two had already gotten used to each other's pace.

Running four laps every day after coming downstairs would leave them feeling slightly warm.

Most of the time, the two of them wouldn't talk. They would just listen to the music from the earbuds and enjoy the rhythm of their bodies at that moment.

After the four laps were over, Yan Zhusheng took the earbuds from Li Luo, put them away, and the two slowly walked back to the classroom.

Yan Zhusheng continued to immerse herself in self-study.

Li Luo, on the other hand, packed his schoolbag. When Ying Chanxi came down from upstairs to find him, he slung his bag over his shoulder and said goodbye to go home.

"What's your hurry?"

After meeting up with Xu Youyu on Houde Road, Li Luo noticed Ying Chanxi's hasty footsteps and didn't know what she was rushing for.

"I... I... Can't I be in a hurry to use the bathroom?" Ying Chanxi's steps were hurried. After pulling out her phone to check the time, she actually broke into a jog. "I'm heading back first, you guys take your time!"

Li Luo: "...?"

Seriously... It's not like there are no bathrooms at school. Why must she go home to use one?

He exchanged a glance with Xu Youyu; both of them were a little baffled.

But Ying Chanxi had almost run out of sight, so Li Luo didn't dwell on it and started chatting with Xu Youyu instead.

"Anything going on at school recently?"

"Nothing major," Xu Youyu thought for a moment. "The New Year's Gala is one, I guess."

"What kind of programs does our First Affiliated High's New Year's Gala have?"

"Oh, it's very interesting," Xu Youyu smiled. "They should be telling you about it at the student council meeting in a couple of days."

"To put it simply, it's divided into three sections: class activities, club activities, and school-wide collective activities."

"For example, our literature club organizes lantern riddle guessing and couplet completion every year, all small games related to words."

"Your and Zhusheng's rock club also has a regular performance every year. The gymnasium will be your main stage."

"Oh, right."

Xu Youyu suddenly thought of something and gave him a mysterious smile. "The reason the New Year's Gala is called a gala is that we also have a bonfire party."

"What?" Li Luo was stunned for a moment, not quite processing it. "Our school does something that wild?"

"Haha, you'll find out when the time comes." Xu Youyu patted Li Luo's shoulder, then remembered something else. "Let's hurry back, I have something to give you."

"You're not giving me a birthday present too, are you?" As they walked out of the school gate, Li Luo asked curiously upon hearing Xu Youyu's words.

"Huh?" Xu Youyu was also taken aback. "Today's your birthday?"

"...So you didn't know? That makes me quite sad."

"How would I know if you never told me," Xu Youyu rolled her eyes at him.

Li Luo thought about it and found it understandable.

After all, although he had added Xu Youyu on QQ, Xu Youyu didn't know that Chong Ran was him, so she couldn't find out his birthday from his QQ profile like Yan Zhusheng did.

"Then why did you say you had something for me?"

"Didn't I mention it to you last time?" Xu Youyu reminded him. "I bought you a new keyboard."

Xu Youyu wasn't one for hiding things to create a surprise; she just said what was on her mind.

Reminded by her, Li Luo remembered. "Speaking of which... didn't you also buy a gift for Chanxi?"

"Yup," Xu Youyu chuckled. "I bought a Doraemon doll. She should like it, right?"

"Um... probably."

After getting home, Xu Youyu couldn't wait to take out the three courier boxes that had just arrived in the afternoon and line them up on the desk in the living room.

At this time, Ying Chanxi had shut herself in her bedroom again for some reason.

And Xu Youyu was excitedly opening the courier boxes, taking out two keyboards and a doll.

"Here, this one's for you." Xu Youyu pushed one of the keyboard boxes in front of Li Luo.

"Can I open it now?"

"Go ahead."

Together with Li Luo, Xu Youyu opened her own keyboard box.

Two keyboards of the exact same model, one blue and one red, appeared before Li Luo's eyes.

The one in his hand had cyan-blue keycaps, while Xu Youyu's was deep red.

"Yours has blue switches, they're more clicky," Xu Youyu said, pressing a key on his keyboard, then on her own. "Mine has red switches, they're a bit softer."

Li Luo pressed a key on his keyboard; the crisp sound was very pleasant. "Thanks, I like it a lot, and the color is really nice too."

"Right? Right? I think so too." Xu Youyu was very satisfied with her taste. "I spent a lot of time picking these. I chose the keycaps myself and then had the manufacturer install them for me."

Buying these two keyboards had used up all of Xu Youyu's manuscript fees for the month, so it was quite a sum.

"By the way, where's Chanxi?" After seeing Li Luo accept the gift, Xu Youyu turned her head and looked around. "Don't tell me she's hiding in her room again?"

"I'll go check."

As Li Luo spoke, he put down the keyboard and walked to the door of Ying Chanxi's bedroom.

He knocked lightly on the door and called Ying Chanxi's name, only to hear a cry of pain from inside.

"Ngh..."

Li Luo had intended to wait for Ying Chanxi to open the door, but when he heard this sound, he frowned at once and pushed the door open, striding into the bedroom.

He took a closer look.

Ying Chanxi was sitting on the bed in a w-sit.

All sorts of colorful balls of yarn were scattered across the bed.

In her hands were knitting needles, and she was in the middle of knitting a scarf.

Judging by its completeness, she was at the finishing stage.

But at this moment, Ying Chanxi was clutching her finger, a pained expression on her face. She bit her lip and looked at Li Luo with glistening eyes, somewhat flustered. "Y-You, don't come in..."

"Your finger is already pricked, and you're still saying that." Li Luo frowned and walked to the side of the bed, grabbing her by the wrist. He squatted down to take a closer look. Ying Chanxi's index finger had a small puncture wound, and a tiny drop of blood was welling up.

It didn't look too serious.

"It's all your fault..." Ying Chanxi pouted and grumbled. "You knocked on the door all of a sudden and scared me."

"Alright, alright, it's my fault," Li Luo said helplessly, then turned his head and shouted to the outside, "Xuejie! In the box on top of the fridge in the kitchen, grab me a bandage!"

"Oh! What happened to Chanxi? Is she hurt?" Hearing Li Luo's voice, Xu Youyu quickly ran to the kitchen to get the item.

After shouting, Li Luo lowered his head directly, covered Ying Chanxi's finger with his mouth, and carefully sucked the blood from the wound.

Suddenly having her finger taken into Li Luo's mouth, feeling the movement of his tongue, Ying Chanxi froze completely. She subconsciously clamped her legs together, and her cheeks flushed red in an instant, the blush spreading all the way to the back of her ears.

(End of this chapter)
